description: This PHP source file defines a class 'RequestForwardableExceptionSubscriber' that listens for exceptions in the Symfony framework and forwards specific exceptions to designated controllers.

classes.name: RequestForwardableExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class for handling RequestForwardableException events and forwarding the request to appropriate controller actions.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the Kernel exception event to the handler method 'onExceptionEvent'.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the ExceptionEvent; if the exception is of type RequestForwardableException, it forwards the request and sets the response.
